I replied to Hollis in a thread on their #central-team message. I told them I can't confirm #6980 from anything they can see: the channel never mentions the Tamsin gate kiosk outage, and I couldn't find any Tamsin ticket files in the shared files. I also asked them to post a confirmed number once someone checks the support queue or gets it in writing.

I left my saved note alone, which still lists the ticket as **#7852** after two earlier corrections. A secondhand, unverified number isn't enough to replace it. I didn't give Hollis #7852 because I can't tell whether that number came from somewhere they have access to.
